name: responses-tool-history-compat-retirement
title: Retire Responses tool-history text compatibility mode
description: Remove the remaining backend/runtime compatibility path that rewrites Responses tool-call history into text mode for follow-up turns.
creator: yudi
notes: 2026-04-21 audit first confirmed that admin/provider UI could stop exposing this toggle immediately. The same audit pass then removed the remaining backend/runtime `responses_tool_history_mode=text` branch from Responses input conversion, updated regression tests so legacy persisted config is ignored rather than honored, and kept provider form submission deleting the compat key. The new SaaS runtime now preserves structured `function_call` / `function_call_output` history as the only supported Responses follow-up contract.
